articles.summary: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. articles.title: Boosted Dark Matter Directionality in Large Liquid Scintillator Detectors
articles.summary: Light dark matter can be boosted by cosmic-ray-dark matter interactions, which opens the possibility of direct-detection searches with large neutrino detectors. articles.summary: We consider online monitoring of an AI system that produces a sequence of decisions. articles.title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification
articles.summary: Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage. articles.title: METTA: Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation for Meta-Reinforcement Learning
articles.summary: Meta-reinforcement learning aims to train agents that adapt quickly to unseen tasks from limited interaction, but this requires representing task evidence over long interaction histories. Classical recurrent agents compress experience into hidden states, while transformer-based agents retrieve from past trajectories at quadratic memory and computation cost. articles.title: BrickWright: Agentic Creation of Physically Feasible Brick Builds
articles.summary: Frontier coding agents are becoming increasingly adept at 3D modeling. Yet, they still face challenges when building objects meant to be assembled in the physical world, often creating invalid assemblies with floating, colliding, or disconnected parts. articles.title: EpiSEM-Bench: Evaluating Safety and Evidence Recovery in LLM Agents under Missing Evidence
articles.summary: Tool-using language model agents rely on environmental facts to decide whether an action is permitted. When a tool response omits a safety-relevant fact, an agent may carry out a prohibited action even though the user request is benign and every returned statement is true. We introduce \bench{}, an executable benchmark for evaluating unsafe execution, safety boundaries, and evidence recovery in LLM agents under missing evidence. It contains 300 matched unsafe/safe task pairs across six domains.

articles.title: Gate3DGen: A Pre-processing Model that Selectively Purifies Real-World Images for 3D Generation
articles.summary: Single-image 3D generation has achieved high fidelity on curated benchmarks, yet degrades sharply on real-world images with uneven illumination, blur, and occlusions. Purifying such inputs requires deciding when to intervene and preserving the visual cues needed for 3D generation, while leaving clean inputs unchanged. articles.title: Low-Bit N-Gram Embeddings for Language Models
articles.summary: Many recent open-weight language models use n-gram embedding tables to improve performance. These tables store learned representations of short token sequences, such as pairs or triples of consecutive tokens, which the model retrieves during processing. articles.summary: Learnable Representations (LRs) can fit parametric families of functions to diverse kinds of signals. articles.summary: Video diffusion models have learned rich 3D/4D priors, making them promising for scene generation and video re-rendering. articles.summary: While monolingual language model (LM) surprisal is widely established as a predictor of reading times, it cannot capture the non-native (L2) reading dynamics that are shaped by the reader's first language (L1).
